environment.device: cpu (Tensix formats emulated; no Tenstorrent device used)

definitions.reference: fp32-stock: unmodified portable NumPy FP32 inner PCG with the two-level preconditioner
definitions.coarse_format: format of (Z^T A Z)^-1 on the FPU; the restricted residual uses fp32/tf32/bf16 to match, bf16 for block floats; FP32 accumulation
definitions.coarse_factor: factored variants store the lower Cholesky factor R of (Z^T A Z)^-1 once and apply R (r^T R)^T; coarse_inverse_bytes counts the dense n x n factor; coarse_matrix_relative_error_vs_fp32 compares R~ R~^T
definitions.stencil_format: format of the operator input vector fed to the portable FP32 action; bf16xK sums K FP32 actions of BF16 pieces in FP32; coefficient rounding not emulated
definitions.rounding: round-to-nearest-even; block floats share the largest exponent of 16 consecutive row values
definitions.solve_ms: CPU emulation wall time, not a Tensix estimate
definitions.viable: every case converges to the outer tolerance with at most one extra outer step, at most 10% more inner iterations, and a solution within 100 x relative_tolerance of fp32-stock

decision.scope: precision feasibility only; nothing in src/ changes. Viable variants are carried to the Blackhole microbenchmark
